title: Impairment of Assets
intro: الأصل **مضمحل** لو قيمته الدفترية أكبر من **القيمة القابلة للاسترداد**.
القيمة القابلة للاسترداد = **الأعلى** بين القيمة العادلة ناقصاً تكاليف الاستبعاد والقيمة الاستخدامية (VIU).
الشهرة تُختبر سنوياً، وخسارة اضمحلالها **لا تُرد أبداً**.

pairs.en: Fair value less costs of disposal

tf.s: An asset is impaired when its carrying amount exceeds its recoverable amount.
Value in use is calculated using a pre-tax discount rate.
tf.why: Cash flows and the rate are both pre-tax.

tf.s: Market capitalisation below net assets may indicate impairment.
Within a CGU, an asset can be written down below the highest of its FVLCD, its value in use and zero.
tf.why: This floor limits the allocation; the excess is spread to the other assets.

tf.s: Impairment losses on goodwill can be reversed in later years.
An impairment loss on an asset carried at cost is recognised in profit or loss.
tf.why: For revalued assets it first reduces the revaluation surplus.

fill.s: Recoverable amount is the ___ of FVLCD and value in use.
Goodwill must be tested for impairment at least ___.
An impairment loss on a CGU is first allocated to ___.
Impairment losses on goodwill are ___ reversed.
